items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: the, uh, of course the college orchestras like Jimmy Joy's and Shakey's and various other Texas Jazzers from Austin College.

ctx.x: Uh, at that time, the, uh, Bob Wills and all of those, uh, bands came a little later. Yeah. But, uh, Dixieland bands were popular in Texas. And, uh, the, uh, of course the college orchestras like Jimmy Joy's and Shakey's and various other Texas Jazzers from Austin College. Mm-hmm. They were all about routine, uh, small clarinet, trumpet, trombone, drums and piano bands. Mm-hmm. And, uh, there could have been the other country bands, but, uh, I, I just really did not, didn't run into them. Yeah. They came from, I…
Yeah, Pud played with the, Pud Brown played with the Rice Brothers, he said, and I thought they'd run it.
